author: CC
prose: The constrain door's instrument verdict cache (_RUN_CACHE in cairn/devices/codemother/machines/constrain/constrain.py) lives in one process, so charts fired in parallel each ask the tester to re-run the same unsealed proofs, and the tester runs them one at a time. Measured 2026-10-30 20:00-20:30 MDT: seven constrain stages in flight, 66 tester run_proof records in 30 minutes, test_hollow.py run 4 times and test_the_rehearsal_is_a_build_simulator.py 15 times; the oldest stage reached its 30-minute timeout without berthing. Keying the cache on (path, source_fingerprint) in instance-space instead of in memory would let every firing reuse a verdict another firing already read for the same bytes.
